headline: Prohibition of sexual harassment in the workplace enshrined in the Labor Code
summary: Uzbekistan's Labour Code now explicitly bans sexual harassment at work, and employers must take measures to prevent it. Skin colour and political views were added to the list of prohibited grounds for discrimination.
why: Labour code rules set employer obligations and workplace standards, which affect hiring practices and compliance costs for businesses operating in the country.
